findings.summary: page = offset // limit is 0-based while paginate expects 1-based pages, so offset=0 raises ValueError and later pages return the previous page's items.
Converting offset to a page number drops the remainder, so offsets that aren't multiples of limit return the wrong items (e.g., offset=10, limit=20 returns items 0–19 instead of 10–29).
limit is not validated: limit=0 raises ZeroDivisionError and a negative limit yields a bad page number.
offset // limit uses the unclamped limit while paginate clamps per_page to MAX_PER_PAGE, so results misalign when limit exceeds MAX_PER_PAGE.
